description: Permanently deletes a contact from Salesforce. This action cannot be undone. Associated records (activities, opportunities) lose the contact reference upon deletion — ensure related data is migrated or acceptable to lose before proceeding. Returns HTTP 204 with empty body on success.

contact_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the contact to delete.
contact_id.human_parameter_description: The unique Salesforce ID of the contact you want to permanently delete. You can find this in the contact's URL or from a previous list or search.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

name: delete_contact

DeleteContactResponse.description:
Response for DELETE Contact operation.

Salesforce DELETE /sobjects/Contact/{id} returns HTTP 204 No Content with an empty response body on success.
Error responses (400/401/403/404/500) return HTTP status codes with JSON array of error objects.

body.description: Response body - null/empty for successful deletion (204), array of error objects for failures
body.title: Body

http_status.description: HTTP status code - 204 for successful deletion, 4xx/5xx for errors
http_status.title: Http Status

DeleteContactResponse.title: DeleteContactResponse

SalesforceError.description: Salesforce API error object returned when DELETE operation fails.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code identifying the type of error (e.g., NOT_FOUND, ENTITY_IS_DELETED, MALFORMED_ID)
errorCode.title: Error Code

fields.description: Array of field names related to the error, if applicable
fields.title: Fields

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong
message.title: Message

SalesforceError.title: SalesforceError
